narrative: The Langflow cross-tenant IDOR (CVE-2026-55255, CVSS 9.9) firing in the wild June 25 is the precipitating origin signal: a flow resolved by opaque UUID with owner checks deferred to the UI on a shared execution endpoint. That is precisely the orchestration-plane underbelly the Multi-tenant agent builders authz-CVE thesis (Jun 27) rests on, and the pattern recurs across n8n/Flowise/Dify.
remaining_gap: A second distinct named platform still needs a CVSS >= 9.0 cross-tenant authz, BOLA, or IDOR advisory; today supplies only the first instance, not the class-confirming recurrence.
